newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Safrica's Erwin says rates higher than he'd like.
newsitem.headline: Safrica's Erwin says rates higher than he'd like.

text.p: South African trade and industry minister Alec Erwin said on Wednesday South African interest rates were higher than the government would like.
However, he told a news conference in Canberra that the economic outlook for South Africa was very good.
"The economy has not been volatile," Erwin said. "Interest rates, unfortunately, I wish they'd been more volatile. They have been relatively steady at a rate higher than we like."
Erwin said short term capital movement had been volatile, affecting the rand until the currency stabilised over the past six or seven months.
"We think the economy is performing well," he said.

"Manufactured exports are rising, private sector investment is rising, government is containing its own expenditure and its fiscal position is good, so the economic outlook for South Africa and its current performance is very good," Erwin said.
